headline: Sensex and Nifty fall sharply as IT stocks lead sell-off amid profit booking

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: IT stocks faced heavy selling pressure, dragging down benchmark indices.
Investors engaged in profit booking following a recent rally in the markets.
Tightening liquidity prompted the RBI to restore the 90% daily CRR requirement for banks.
Markets caught their breath after a 15% rally over four weeks.
whatHappening: Sensex dropped over 700 points while Nifty slipped below the 25,650 mark.
Zee Entertainment announced its buyback will open on December 1 and close on December 7.
Karnataka issued a show-cause notice to an IOCL terminal over excess ethanol blending.
Metals outperformed during the trading session despite broader market declines.
summary: Indian equities traded lower as heavy selling in IT stocks and widespread profit booking dragged the Sensex down by over 700 points. Nifty slipped below 25,650, snapping its recent upward trajectory amid tightening banking liquidity measures by the RBI. In corporate developments, Zee Entertainment announced its share buyback timeline, while IOC faced regulatory notices in Karnataka.
